vocabulary.meaning_en: to write down what a caller wants to tell someone
vocabulary.example: Could I take a message?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to phone someone who phoned you earlier
vocabulary.example: I'll call you back in ten minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: suitable, not causing problems
vocabulary.example: When is a convenient time to call?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who makes a phone call
vocabulary.example: The caller didn't leave a name.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give a message to another person
vocabulary.example: I'll pass that on to him.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to wait for a short time (on the phone)
vocabulary.example: Hold on, I'll get a pen.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the ability to wait calmly
vocabulary.example: Thanks for your patience.

vocabulary.meaning_en: now
vocabulary.example: He's not here at the moment.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have none left
vocabulary.example: We've run out of paper.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tool that joins papers with metal pins
vocabulary.example: Has anyone seen the stapler?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document asking a customer to pay for goods or work
vocabulary.example: Please send the invoice to the client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: office work with documents and forms
vocabulary.example: Denise usually does the paperwork.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to send something to many people or to a customer
vocabulary.example: Has the invoice been sent out?

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a state of complete confusion
vocabulary.example: The office has been chaotic all week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very busy and full of activity
vocabulary.example: It was a hectic day at the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep behaving in a correct work manner
vocabulary.example: Even when you're busy, remain professional.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way you think and behave
vocabulary.example: He has a good attitude to work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not polite
vocabulary.example: Don't be rude to callers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
vocabulary.example: How will the team cope without Denise?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person to help with work
vocabulary.example: We could do with another pair of hands.

vocabulary.meaning_en: would benefit from having something
vocabulary.example: The office could do with more staff.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that might buy from you
vocabulary.example: That caller could be a potential client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: small paper bags with tea inside
vocabulary.example: We've run out of teabags.

fine_lines.title: call back vs call again
fine_lines.explanation_ar: call back تعني أن تتصل بشخص ردًا على اتصاله السابق. call again تعني أن يتصل الشخص نفسه مرة أخرى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Call back' = return someone's call. 'Call again' = phone another time yourself.

examples.sentence: I'll make sure he calls you back.
He's busy. Could you call again later?

fine_lines.title: hectic vs chaotic
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hectic يعني مزدحمًا جدًا بالعمل لكنه قد يكون منظمًا. chaotic يعني فوضويًا بلا تنظيم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hectic = very busy. Chaotic = disorganised and confused.

examples.sentence: It's a hectic week, but we're managing.
Nobody knew what to do – it was chaotic.

expressions.phrase: We're a bit busy at the moment; could I take your name and number and we'll call you back?
expressions.meaning_ar: نحن مشغولون قليلًا الآن؛ هل يمكنني أخذ اسمك ورقمك وسنعاود الاتصال بك؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to deal with a call when you're busy.
expressions.example: We're a bit busy at the moment; could I take your name and number and we'll call you back?

expressions.phrase: When would be a convenient time to call you?
expressions.meaning_ar: متى يكون الوقت المناسب للاتصال بك؟
expressions.meaning_en: What time is good for you?
expressions.example: When would be a convenient time to call you tomorrow?

expressions.phrase: Could I take a message please and I'll make sure he calls you back?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني أخذ رسالة وسأتأكد من أنه سيعاود الاتصال بك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Let me write your message and he will phone you.
expressions.example: She's in a meeting. Could I take a message, and I'll make sure she calls you back?
Thanks for your patience. I have your file now.

expressions.phrase: He doesn't seem to be here at the moment.
expressions.meaning_ar: يبدو أنه ليس موجودًا في الوقت الحالي.
expressions.example: I'm sorry, he doesn't seem to be here at the moment.
Call Bob about the order? OK, I'll pass that on.

expressions.phrase: Hello, Tip Top Trading, Anna speaking.
expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا، تيب توب تريدينغ، آنا تتحدث.
expressions.meaning_en: A professional way to answer the phone at work.
expressions.example: Good morning, Star Hotel, Omar speaking.

grammar.title: would for polite questions
grammar.explanation_ar: When would be a convenient time? أكثر تهذيبًا من When is a good time? استخدام would و could يجعل السؤال ألطف.
grammar.explanation_en: Using would and could makes questions more polite.
examples: When would be a convenient time to call you?
Could I take your name and number?
Would you like to leave a message?

grammar.title: make sure + subject + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: make sure تعني «أتأكد من أن»، وبعدها جملة كاملة بالمضارع حتى للمستقبل: I'll make sure he calls you back.
grammar.explanation_en: 'Make sure' is followed by a full clause in the present simple, even for the future.
examples: I'll make sure he calls you back.
Make sure you write down the number.
I'll make sure the invoice is sent today.

grammar.title: Present perfect passive: has been sent
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال عن عمل يجب أن يكون قد تم: Has the invoice been sent out yet? (has/have + been + التصريف الثالث).
grammar.explanation_en: Use has/have + been + past participle to ask if a job is done.
examples: Has that invoice been sent out yet?
Have the messages been passed on?

questions.question: When would be a ___ time to call you?
Could I take a ___ please and I'll make sure he calls you back?
I'll make sure he ___ you back.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد make sure نستخدم المضارع: he calls.
questions.explanation_en: After 'make sure' use the present simple.

questions.question: Tom says 'We're very busy, so call back later. Bye.' Why is this bad?
choices: It's rude – the caller could be a client
questions.explanation_ar: يجب أن نبقى مهذبين؛ قد يكون المتصل عميلًا.
questions.explanation_en: It's rude; the caller might be a client.

questions.question: We've ___ pens and paper.
questions.explanation_en: 'Run out of' means have none left.

questions.question: Which is the best way to answer a work phone?
choices: Hello, Tip Top Trading, Anna speaking.
questions.explanation_ar: الرد المهني يذكر اسم الشركة واسمك.
questions.explanation_en: Say the company and your name.

questions.question: The office is very busy and full of activity. It's ___.
